# kits/beast-riders: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

The Beast Riders kit (catalog culture beast-rider): the riders' buildings as a set of their own, on the catalog's engine: its own mounts' buildings (the raptor stable with its paddock, the great byre for threehorns and hardshells, the rookery tower for the flyers) and Girder's and Mav's Refuge's thirteen (kits/catalog, read in place); the sedentary trades for every Voth census trade without electricity (BR_TRADES) and the larger houses and the farmhouse (src/51-54); the rock-cut pieces and the Deep Root cavern's dressing (BR_ROCK, src/55-56; rooms in kits/interiors/sets/beast-rider-rock.js); the tent set of hide domes and barrel pavilions with every Scyvoi trade, the pens and trainers, the thorn hedge and rail fence, and BR_CAMP, each of the twelve tribes' camp (src/70-79); the library's detail maps at building scale; the catalog's inspector, hover and polygon tools. Verified: build.py, verify.py --assert. Read README.md

Docs: `KNOWN_ISSUES.md`, `PORT.md`, `README.md`

Built output (never open it; edit `src/` and rebuild): `dist/beast-riders.html`

Build: `cd kits/beast-riders && python3 build.py`. Fragments are concatenated in filename order.
